title: Detailed taco
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Taco shell - outer golden curve -->
  <path d='M10 65 Q10 25 50 20 Q90 25 90 65 Q90 80 50 85 Q10 80 10 65 Z' fill='#E8A825' stroke='#F2C94C' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Shell inner lighter area -->
  <path d='M18 63 Q18 33 50 28 Q82 33 82 63 Q82 74 50 78 Q18 74 18 63 Z' fill='#F0C050' stroke='#F7D870' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Shell texture lines -->
  <path d='M25 45 Q35 40 45 42' fill='none' stroke='#D4941A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M55 40 Q65 38 75 44' fill='none' stroke='#D4941A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M22 58 Q32 54 42 56' fill='none' stroke='#D4941A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M58 55 Q68 52 78 57' fill='none' stroke='#D4941A' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Lettuce layer - green ruffles -->
  <path d='M14 52 Q18 44 26 48 Q30 40 38 46 Q42 38 50 44 Q58 37 64 45 Q70 40 76 48 Q82 44 86 52 L84 60 Q78 55 72 60 Q66 54 60 60 Q54 53 48 60 Q42 54 36 60 Q30 55 24 60 Q18 56 14 52 Z' fill='#4CAF50' stroke='#81C784' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Meat layer - brown seasoned chunks -->

  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#A0582A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#A0582A'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#A0582A'/>

  <!-- Cheese layer - yellow drips -->
  <path d='M20 44 Q28 38 36 43 Q44 37 52 42 Q60 36 68 42 Q74 38 80 44 L78 50 Q72 44 66 50 Q58 43 52 50 Q44 44 38 50 Q30 45 24 50 Q18 46 20 44 Z' fill='#FFD700' stroke='#FFEA70' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Cheese drips hanging -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q30 50 28 54' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 42 Q50 48 47 53' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 43 Q68 49 65 54' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tomato chunks - red -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#E53935' stroke='#EF9A9A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='39' r='3' fill='#E53935' stroke='#EF9A9A' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='41' r='3.2' fill='#E53935' stroke='#EF9A9A' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Onion bits - purple/white -->
  <path d='M40 38 Q42 36 44 38' fill='none' stroke='#CE93D8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 37 Q60 35 62 37' fill='none' stroke='#CE93D8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 42 Q48 40 50 42' fill='none' stroke='#E1BEE7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Sour cream dollop - white/light -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FAFAFA' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF' stroke='#F5F5F5' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Top cilantro leaves - small green accents -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='33' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#66BB6A' transform='rotate(-20 44 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='33' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#66BB6A' transform='rotate(20 56 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#81C784'/>

  <!-- Shell bottom shadow highlight -->
  <path d='M20 72 Q50 78 80 72' fill='none' stroke='#F7D870' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
